title: Majelis Tadarus 5T
lead: Learning Tadarus of the Qur'an with the 5T method, for students and the wider public — in small, warm circles, week after week.

general.title: General goals
items: Living the sunnah of reciting and studying the Qur'an together.
Living the values of the Qur'an every day.

specific.title: Specific goal
items: Being able to reflect on and enjoy the Qur'an on one's own.

curriculum.text: It starts with the short, familiar surahs and moves step by step to the following juz and selected verses.

method.title: How we learn
items: Questions and answers between teacher and participants.

tadarus.title: Kitab Tadarus Mubtadi
tadarus.text: The circle's main reference, following the 5T method: Tamhid, Tafsir, Tadabbur through Tazkiyah.

children.title: Qur'anic Education for Children
children.text: Shapes a Qur'anic character through the surahs from ad-Duha to an-Nas, with practice tasks.
